Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the period below.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure period (all day)】

December 4, 2026 (Friday, Reiwa 8) through January 15, 2027 (Friday)

【Service changes during closure】

• In-library browsing, book lending, and returns at the Children's Library will not be available.

• If you have reserved materials to pick up at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Main Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
